description: X conversion image pixels on analytics.twitter.com/i/adsct, analytics.x.com, and t.co. txn_id is the conversion ID. Generated pixels send p_id=Twitter. tw_sale_amount and tw_order_quantity ride on purchase fires. twclid is the click ID X documents for matching. X documents twq, not this query. The conversion API stays vendor/x-conversions-api.

params.name: txn_id
params.description: It is the conversion or pixel ID the website tag fires. X documents the JavaScript tag rather than this query, so the rule is ecosystem evidence.
params.fix_hint: Copy the conversion ID from the generated website tag so `txn_id` carries it.

params.name: p_id
params.fix_hint: Keep `p_id=Twitter` from the generated website tag.

params.name: tw_sale_amount
params.description: Purchase fires send the revenue amount. Generated pixels use a number with no currency symbol.
params.fix_hint: Set tw_sale_amount to a number such as 10 or 10.50, not $10.

params.name: tw_order_quantity
params.description: Purchase fires send the item count as an integer.
params.fix_hint: Set tw_order_quantity to the item count, digits only.

params.name: twclid
params.description: It is the X click identifier from the landing URL. X documents twclid as a matching identifier on the pixel and the conversion API. Page fires without an ad click omit it.
params.fix_hint: Set twclid to the click ID from the landing URL query, or drop the pair when there was no click.
